title: 第1340章 那我们先走了第1339章 阿瑞斯失态
content_zh:
阿瑞斯不仅是他的至交好友，还是他的队友，是那种可以将后背，交给对方的那一种！
“吉恩大人，实在是不好意思，阿瑞斯已经被仇恨冲昏了头脑。迪娅.狄是他的恋人。因为调查克劳公爵，私通邪神一事而死。”
“所以阿瑞斯认为迪娅的死，肯定和克劳公爵有关。而刚刚他离的远，实力也低微。”
“没有听到，您与克劳公爵的对话。所以才有如此乌龙之事，还请吉恩大人原谅。”亨特马上接道。
亨特一看杰西斯，将阿瑞斯拉住了，才开口解释。
这种事不是他不想帮忙，而是他的力量也很有限。
大家都道他半神强者，只有他才知道，普通职业者终难成气候，只有那远离凡尘的修士，才是真正的强大。
“我能够理解他。但是再大的仇恨，在有规则的情况下，你还是要按照规则来。”
“如果你认为你很强大，就可以不遵守规则。那么不好意思，这世上还有，比你更强大的存在。”
“如果大家都不遵守规则，那弱者将无处生存。整个塔玛拉世界，也都将充满了混乱、无序。我想，这也不是你们神殿想要的结果吧？”吉恩面无表情的说道。
对于规则，吉恩自认为自己，还算是一个能遵守规则的人。
因为规则大部分时候，是用来约束强者，保护弱者的。
只是，如果有一天强者不遵守规则，那整个世界，都会混乱不堪。
吉恩为何会不高兴？
不仅仅是，这次苏家做出来的事，更主要的是，伊维里欧斯家族嫁过来的女性，还有刚刚阿瑞斯的冲动。
这千年来，他有两次对神殿，产生了厌恶，其中一次就是，刚刚来到季风镇之时。
神殿被瓦安家族利用，针对季风镇展开了，一系列的军事行动。
虽然最终是以神殿失败，然后双方也是以和解方式而告终，但当时神殿，给吉恩的印象就很差。
感觉被有心人一利用，就会被人牵着鼻子走？
整个希望之城神殿系统，都是酒囊饭袋？

还有就是现在！
身为神殿的战士，面对上峰下达的命令，视若无睹，还要冲上来质问。
你要知道你是战斗人员，不是在神殿引导信众祈祷的工作人员，不同的岗位就有不同的职责。
有些话说出来搞笑，虽然现实之中做不到，但吉恩一直都是这样要求自己的，职位不分高低贵贱。
普通人会有喜怒哀乐，不代表贵族、领主就没有喜怒哀乐，某些情况来看，大家都是一样的。
你在什么位置，就要做好什么事，如果你做不到，那没关系，“天”会给你记着。
其实死亡并不是生命的终结，三维空间中的众生，最终只有一个归宿那就是超脱。
不能超脱，管你是谁，在什么位置，终难逃重置清零。
普通生灵的喜怒哀乐，对于守护者来说，不过是司空见惯，守护者不会因为你可怜而可怜你，也不会因为你有权势而垂青你。
而现在的阿瑞斯、克劳.苏，都属于那种欲望超越了理智、能力的人。
这不就显得神殿的管理，很失败吗？
而自己却一直在，和这种势力合作！
虽然有一部分，是看在绾的面子上。
毕竟，推行谁的信仰不是推行，还不如推行一个，自己熟悉的神族！
这让吉恩再次深思，这样做带给各个星球，生灵的到底是好是坏了。
content_en:
Ares is not only his best friend, but also his teammate, the kind who can give his back to the opponent!
"Lord Jean, I'm really sorry. Ares has been blinded by hatred. Dia. Di was his lover. He died because of his investigation of Duke Crow and his affair with the evil god."
"So Ares thinks that Dia's death must be related to Duke Crow. But just now he was far away and his strength was low."
"I didn't hear the conversation between you and Duke Crow. That's why there was such an inexplicable thing. Please forgive me Lord Jean." Hunter immediately answered.
Hunter looked at Jesses, pulled Ares back, and then opened his mouth to explain.
It's not that he doesn't want to help with this kind of thing, but that his power is also very limited.
Everyone calls him a powerful demigod, but only he knows that ordinary professionals will never achieve success. Only monks who are far away from the mortal world are truly powerful.
"I can understand him. But no matter how much hatred there is, if there are rules, you still have to follow the rules."
"If you think you are powerful, you don't have to follow the rules. Then I'm sorry, there are other beings in this world who are more powerful than you."
"If everyone does not abide by the rules, the weak will have nowhere to survive. The entire world of Tamara will be full of chaos and disorder. I think this is not the result your temple wants, right?" Jean said expressionlessly.
Regarding rules, Gene considers himself to be a person who can abide by the rules.
Because most of the time rules are used to restrain the strong and protect the weak.
However, if one day the strong do not abide by the rules, the whole world will be in chaos.
Why is Gene upset?
Not only what the Su family did this time, but more importantly, the women married by the Ivelious family, and Ares' impulse just now.
In the past thousand years, he had developed a dislike for the temple twice, one of which was when he first came to Monsoon Town.
The temple was used by the Waan family to launch a series of military operations against Monsoon Town.
Although the temple failed in the end and the two parties reconciled, the temple gave Jean a very bad impression at that time.
Do you feel that if someone takes advantage of you, you will be led around?
Is the entire City of Hope temple system a waste of money?
And now!
As a warrior in the temple, he turned a blind eye to the orders given by his superiors and rushed up to question them.
You must know that you are a combatant, not a staff member who leads believers in prayer at a temple. Different positions have different responsibilities.
Some of the things he said were funny. Although he couldn't do it in reality, Gene had always demanded of himself in this way. There was no distinction between high and low positions.
Ordinary people have joys and sorrows, but it does not mean that nobles and lords do not have joys and sorrows. In some cases, everyone is the same.
Wherever you are, you have to do something well. If you can't do it, it doesn't matter, "Heaven" will remember it for you.
In fact, death is not the end of life. All living beings in the three-dimensional space ultimately have only one destination, which is transcendence.
You can't detach yourself. No matter who you are or where you are, you can't escape the reset.
The joys and sorrows of ordinary creatures are just commonplace to the guardians. The guardians will not pity you because you are pitiful, nor will they favor you because you are powerful.
And now Ares and Klaue Su are the kind of people whose desires exceed reason and ability.
Doesn’t this show that the temple’s management has failed?
But I have been cooperating with this kind of force!
Although part of it is for Wan's sake.
After all, promoting someone's beliefs is not promoting, it is better to promote a god clan that you are familiar with!
This made Jean think deeply again, whether this would bring good or bad effects to the living beings on various planets.
